Stanbic IBTC Nigerian Equity Fund

Highlights
  • The Stanbic IBTC Nigerian Equity Fund (SINEF) was launched in February 1997
  • The Fund invests a minimum of 70% of its portfolio in equity securities quoted on the Nigerian Exchange Limited (NGX), and a maximum of 30% in high quality fixed income securities
  • The Fund has a 91-day minimum holding period
  • The penalty for redeeming within the minimum holding period is 20% on the accrued income
  • The minimum investment amount is N5,000.00 
  • It is an open-ended fund
  • The risk profile of the Fund is “Aggressive”
  • The management fee is 3.0% per annum
